summary: Implemented print_json across rich: JSONHighlighter (highlighter.py), new rich/json.py with JSON renderable and __main__ CLI, Console.print_json (console.py), package-level print_json (__init__.py), six json.* theme styles (default_styles.py), docs (console.rst Printing JSON section, reference/json.rst, reference.rst toctree), CHANGELOG Added entry, and new tests/test_json.py. No commits made. Tests were not run; the expected ANSI codes in test_print_json_styled_output were derived by reading Style._make_ansi_codes and need verification. Notes: JSON module imports Console only inside the __main__ block to support soft_wrap in the CLI, which is a tension with the 'must not import console' rule; overflow set to Python None; running rich/json.py as a script shadows stdlib json, so use python -m rich.json.
